subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Baptism and Sacred Water
description: A quick, practical guide to Baptism and Sacred Water.

hook.text: Jesus was baptized in the Jordan River. John dunked him and the Spirit descended. Water transformed identity.

buildup.text: Baptism means dying to the old self and rising clean. Water is the medium of spiritual rebirth in Christianity.

discovery.text: Jewish mikveh, Hindu river bathing, and Islamic wudu all use water for purification. The symbol crosses all faiths.

twist.text: Water purifies because it destroys—floods erase everything. The same power that kills also cleanses.

climax.text: Sacred water rituals say transformation requires immersion. You must go under to come back different.

punchline.text: Go under. Come up new. Water decides.

quiz.question: What do baptism, mikveh, and wudu have in common?
options: They use water for spiritual purification
